resource: CONTAINER_VIEW_INTENT commands (command type 21) of one GameSession
allocation_impact: A per-session window of at most 10 command instants in any 1 s. Each command makes at most one observation read and one whole-view domain 14 delta (at most 10,384 bytes), so a session costs at most 10 reads and about 104 KB of deltas per second. An over-rate command has no effect and gets CommandStatus REJECTED with an empty payload; the result set is unchanged.
boundary_tests: max=10: ten commands in one second are served
max+1=11: an eleventh command in the same second is REJECTED without effect; one a second later is served
notes: BAGS-0 §5 and §10 (measured and registered by BAGS-WIRE-1); the window is per GameSession and survives reconnect, resume and transfer; tests: container_view::tests::view_commands_are_limited_to_10_per_second, container_view::tests::the_view_command_window_is_carried_across_reconnect_and_transfer, container_view::tests::connection::the_view_command_rate_is_per_game_session_across_a_reconnect.
